card.name: Words inside cardiac and beta-blocker passages
card.fires_on: Linking words and word parts in heart-related drug text, such as beta-blocker withdrawal, ventricular pacing and sympathetic response. The next word is often a cardiac or withdrawal term.

modes.label: Linking word after withdrawal
modes.description: Small words like by or an right after withdrawal or precipitate, before a syndrome or exacerbation.
modes.example: Abrupt withdrawal of beta-blockade may be followed<< by>> an exacerbation of the symptoms of hyper

modes.label: Partway through cardiac terms
modes.description: Part of a cardiac or autonomic word, such as vent-ricular, adrenergic or pulse-less.

modes.label: Word before hypotension or response
modes.description: Words like dose or sympathetic that come before a blood pressure or stress-response term.
